sayDuring.line: ◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The grass is humming. In harmony. That's not grass — that's fifty throats, one note, and it's getting louder.
Your teeth ache with it. You don't know what it wants.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The humming in the grass. Someone at the haven should hear about this.

Carolina holds very still. "That's new. That's new and bad."

ringBefore.line: 👥 Nora heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to."
👥 Nadia walks out with Nora. "Nobody walks alone today."
Marcus heads out to forage. "Back before dark. Probably."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
You catch fragments by the fire — Tashi telling Nadia about Carolina. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Marisol opens the pantry wide: 24× Blackberry. Devon, Deo eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−1,560 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
🍖 FEASTED ×2.03 until tomorrow's dawn (6 parts left): a proper feast. A channeled keepsake feeds the flames (devotion ×1.5). Strikes and abilities hit with the feast behind them.

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Moderator is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
